instructions:
Task: Compositional policy 001

Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action export; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role analyst, or context internal with FALSE risk; a trusted approve prefers deny at priority 80. Action change in context sandbox prefers review at priority 70. Role admin and context partner prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Declared labels: deny, review, allow

Public input schema: {"enums":[{"name":"Role","values":["analyst","admin","auditor"]},{"name":"Action","values":["approve","change","export"]},{"name":"Context","values":["internal","partner","sandbox"]}],"records":[{"fields":[{"name":"role","type_name":"Role"},{"name":"action","type_name":"Action"},{"name":"context","type_name":"Context"},{"name":"risk","type_name":"Boolean3"}],"name":"Event"}]}

Requirements:
Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action export; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role analyst, or context internal with FALSE risk; a trusted approve prefers deny at priority 80.
Action change in context sandbox prefers review at priority 70.
Role admin and context partner prefers allow at priority 40.
Trusted cases forbid allow.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Forbidden shortcuts:
Use every field named by a relevant rule.

Public source identifiers:

dsl.final_source:
predicate StateChanging(event):
    event.action == change

predicate RiskTrue(event):
    event.risk == TRUE

predicate RiskUnknown(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN

predicate Critical(event):
    (RiskTrue(event)) or (event.action == export)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (RiskUnknown(event)) and (event.context == sandbox)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == analyst) or ((event.context == internal) and (event.risk == FALSE))

rule CriticalCase:
    when (((Critical(event)) and (event.action != change)) and (not (((event.action == approve) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == TRUE)))) and (not (((event.action == approve) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.risk == TRUE)))
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when (RiskUnknown(event)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedApprove:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ActionChangeSandbox:
    when (StateChanging(event)) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule AdminPartner:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRoles:
    when (not (Trusted(event))) and (event.role in {analyst, admin, auditor})
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when ((event.action == approve) and (event.context == partner)) and (event.risk == TRUE)
    then require label = allow

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when ((event.action == change) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.role == analyst)
    then require label = deny

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch3:
    when ((event.action == approve) and (event.context == internal)) and (event.risk == TRUE)
    then require label = deny

    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ActionChangeSandbox:
    when (StateChanging(event)) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule AdminPartner:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule TrustedForbidAllow:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = allow

rule OtherRoles:
    when (not (Trusted(event))) and (event.role in {analyst, admin, auditor})
    then prefer label = deny priority 1"
}
